intake.duplicate_effort: none for FlashKDA itself (no AMD-Ecosystem or ROCm fork, no AMD mention in upstream docs); the KDA capability reaches AMD via fla-org/flash-linear-attention's Triton fla/ops/kda, CI-tested on MI300
intake.summary: MIT (tier 1) Hopper/Blackwell-only KDA attention kernels written entirely in CUTLASS/CuTe -- 24 SM90_TMA sites, sm90 cluster pipelines, archs 90a/100a/103a/120a; CuTe has no ROCm backend and TMA no AMD equivalent, so this is a from-scratch CK/HIP kernel rewrite rather than a port on CDNA as much as RDNA, and AMD users already get KDA through flash-linear-attention's Triton path (CI-tested on MI300)
